definition: Reverie is a vague, dreamy state of consciousness in which attention to one’s surroundings is reduced by mental preoccupation. In this historical source it is grouped with absent-minded or abstracted states such as “brown-study.”

provenance.revision: 1901 New York Macmillan original; archive index checked 2026-10-18
provenance.scope: Source record Absent-mindedness; pinned source text
